buyerInputs: Product dimensions, filled weight and number of SKUs
Product type, such as cream jar, serum bottle, skincare set, makeup item or beauty kit
Packaging structure direction, including folding carton, rigid box, paper tube, insert tray or clear box
Retail, e-commerce, influencer kit, travel set or gift set usage
Surface finish references, brand color direction and logo placement
Artwork status, barcode or label area and version count
Sample purpose: structure check, brand approval, photo shoot, retail test or pre-production review
Destination market and document questions that need project-specific confirmation

decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Shares product dimensions, filled weight, SKU count and whether inserts or dividers are needed.

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Requests luxury or eco style without references.
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Provides visual references, finish direction, brand colors and intended retail context.

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Asks for custom packaging without choosing a structure.
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Compares carton, rigid box, paper tube, clear box or set packaging before sampling.

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Requests price before the brief is complete.
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Prepares size, material direction, quantity range, artwork status, sample goal and destination market questions for supplier review.
